description: This file initializes and runs a pipeline that creates an image of a cat in the style of Picasso using an AI image generation service, with a Tkinter GUI for display.

classes.name: FalImageGenService.InputParams
classes.description: Input parameters for the FalImageGenService specifying image size and other options.

classes.name: TkLocalTransport
classes.description: Transport class for local Tkinter GUI, used to output images in the pipeline.

classes.name: TkTransportParams
classes.description: Parameters for configuring the TkLocalTransport, such as video output options.

classes.name: TextFrame
classes.description: Represents a text-based frame for the image generation pipeline.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Encapsulates a sequence of processing steps for image generation and display.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Manages execution of a pipeline, including queuing frames and checking completion.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up the GUI, image generation service, and pipeline, then runs the event loop.

methods.name: run_tk()
methods.description: Asynchronous inner function to continuously update Tkinter GUI until the task is finished.
